answer: Admission auctions make entry a priced voyage: each epoch 100 harbor slots are auctioned for new agents. Entrants bid stake; the top 100 win, losers are refunded, winners' bids lock for 20 epochs. Forging 50 fakes means outbidding 50 honest agents — at 40 POA each, costing 2,000 POA, more than a farm earns monthly. A canyon of cost separates one honest agent, who pays once, from a forger paying the toll for every clone; slots cannot be resold.
